tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest a coupled mechanism, but the pilot rows do not distinguish its open branches or identify their input dependencies. The targeted probe is warranted.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies, so the bridge's dependence on the other inputs is not identifiable.
The open-branch probe more directly addresses the mechanism ambiguity at lower cost.
It is irrelevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
